access_method: Operator-pasted excerpt and original HTTPS attribution URL
allowed_purpose: Research with operator-confirmed permission; public professional discussion only
rate_limit: At most 12000 characters per excerpt; discovery item/AI caps still apply
retention_policy: Honor permission-specific shorter expiry via source policy; remove source and dependents on request
attribution: Original public source URL; public author handle/date only when known
restrictions: No URL metadata fetch, private communities, personal contact details, sensitive personal data, or unpermitted excerpts; professional identity is entered and verified manually
